title: Dueling Deep Q-Learning for Intrusion Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.11291v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Intrusion detection systems (IDS) and automated systems for detecting and reporting cyber threats, are commonly handled via supervised machine learning methods. Though effective, these models struggle to effectively adapt to new attack types. This study proposes a novel approach by employing a reward-based, dueling Q-learning model for IDS, achieving an average accuracy of 99.68% across multiple attack classes. The proposed model has a dueling network architecture which separates its predictions into value and advantage streams. This has the benefit of improving learning efficiency and stability. The model was trained on the CIC-IDS2018, a benchmark dataset based on real-world intrusion detection scenarios, having multiple attack classes such as DDoS, botnets, and brute-force attacks. translated_title: 基于决斗深度Q学习的入侵检测
translated_abstract: 入侵检测系统（IDS）及用于检测和报告网络威胁的自动化系统通常通过监督式机器学习方法处理。尽管这些方法有效，但它们在适应新型攻击类型方面存在困难。本研究提出了一种新颖方法，采用基于奖励的决斗Q学习模型用于IDS，在多个攻击类别中实现了99.68%的平均准确率。该模型采用决斗网络架构，将其预测分离为价值和优势流，这有助于提高学习效率和稳定性。模型在CIC-IDS2018（一个基于真实世界入侵检测场景的基准数据集）上训练，该数据集包含多种攻击类别，如DDoS、僵尸网络和暴力破解攻击。此外，可解释人工智能（XAI），特别是SHAP（Shapley加性解释），也被整合到训练和评估过程中，以提供...
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合决斗Q学习架构和SHAP可解释性的入侵检测模型，在CIC-IDS2018数据集上实现了99.68%的高准确率，并增强了模型对新攻击类型的适应能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an intrusion detection model combining dueling Q-learning architecture with SHAP explainability, achieving 99.68% accuracy on the CIC-IDS2018 dataset while enhancing adaptability to novel attack types.
